pkgmetadata.longdescription: Bash CLI to manage Gentoo stage tarballs: list, chroot (use/rebase), convert, export, delete, rename, download official stage3 images, and per-stage notes. Supports folder/tmpfs/zram storage, optional host bind mounts, and ccache sidecars.

use.flag: Use app-arch/lbzip2 (via app-alternatives) for parallel bzip2
Use app-arch/pigz (via app-alternatives) for parallel gzip
Use app-arch/pxz for parallel xz; without it depend on app-arch/xz-utils
Enable zram storage backend (requires CONFIG_ZRAM and ext2-capable FS in the kernel)
